acceptance: External only. Hashes, schemas and model assertions cannot certify native, physical, AT/IME or requirement acceptance.

noProgress.action: end this investigation and select another bounded mandatory slice; do not globally block work

optionalCheckArgument: --base-ref REF checks archival implementation changes in a Git diff
checkRequireRecord: --require-record fails without participant slice; mandatory implementation continuations use this flag

claimTypes.scope: nonempty string describing actual evidence scope (no oracle certified)
claimTypes.evidence: nonempty array of {path: repository-relative nonsymlink file, sha256: 64-character hash}
claimTypes.sourceHashes: object mapping every selected path to current SHA256 string
claimTypes.reviewer: nonempty string unless accepted; then independent reviewer object
claimTypes.sourceTuple: required for accepted: object with nonempty sourceRevision/core/plugin/toolchain identity values

dirtyAdoption.meaning: Explicit contributor ownership assertion; only declared currently dirty product paths can be adopted. Other dirty paths remain protected. Never infer ownership from a selected path.

inspect: inspect --requirement ID (repeat 1–3) returns authoritative original requirement, exact scenarios/oracles, current ledger row and source pointers. Optional repeatable --scenario EXACT_NAME narrows original and ledger scenarios together, keeps all other fields and reports originalScenarioCount/omittedScenarios plus scenarioFilter and ledgerSha256. Unknown/duplicate names or an inspected requirement without a matching selected scenario fail. No selection, mutation or evidence validation.
progressMeaning: Changed authored .elm/.c/.h/.cpp/.hpp/.py/.css/.svg files under candidate src/native/adapter/assets and the explicit authoredJavascript paths count as production-fix. QA, compiled bundles, unknown JS, docs and other artifact changes do not. New iterations use progressPolicy=3; absent/1 excludes C++ and all JS, and 2 includes C++ but excludes all JS. Historical records retain their original interpretation. Source bytes are implementation observations, never feature or oracle acceptance.
historicalEvidence: record preserves prior immutable claims but marks historicalAfterSourceChange on relevant source changes; their evidence remains intact and current acceptance is explicitly invalidated. A fresh stale current claim still fails check.
selfAttestation: Local records are contributor self-attestations and may be edited. Derived progress, hashes and structural checks detect listed inconsistencies; they cannot establish independent ownership, actual observation, reviewer identity or certified acceptance.
duplicateVerdicts: Same requirement/scenario/disposition/scope/missing-observations verdict does not count again as meaningful progress, even with new evidence hashes/timestamps.
acceptedRestrictions: No missing observations; independent reviewer differs from owner and has disposition accepted; retained nonempty evidence is neither selected product source nor Git-ignored scratch. Partial/blocked verdict requires missing observation. Accepted sourceRevision must be a full immutable commit hash, and every claimed source hash must match a regular file blob in that exact commit. Mutable refs, abbreviated hashes, absent files, symlinks and mismatched committed bytes fail. Historical source claims retain their original revision and become noncurrent after relevant changes. This binding checks source identity, not the evidence contents, reviewer honesty, native/AT oracle or actual core/plugin/toolchain identity.
projectOnly: check --project-only bypasses participant records; incompatible with --require-record. --base-ref archive diff checked with or without record, with rename endpoints preserved.
checkerIdentity: Default root discovered from cwd ancestors; executed checker bytes must match repository-owned checker. checkerSha256 accompanies every result.
recordWrites: POSIX exclusive lock serializes start/record. Start uses atomic exclusive creation; record uses atomic fsynced replacement. Git environment routing/index variables scrubbed.
plan: Read-only plan --id ID --requirement ORIGINAL_ID --scenario ORIGINAL_NAME --path CANDIDATE_FILE --before TEXT --after TEXT --verify TEXT (repeat requirement/scenario/path/verify as needed). Global --json prints a planSchema=1 packet containing slice and exact original scenarios/verification. start --slice-file accepts this packet or a bare slice. Plan does not select STATE, adopt drafts or write files. Saved planSchema=1 packets are checked against exact selected original scenario objects and verification when loaded by preflight/start; copied-oracle changes fail.
handoff: Read-only participant resume packet: current source hashes/revision, changes since last record, protected foreign paths, latest recorded observation per selected original scenario, missing observations and structural/no-progress findings. evidenceMatchesCurrentSources means matching current source/evidence hashes, not oracle truth or acceptance. Missing records fail explicitly; stale current evidence returns nonzero with the packet.
doctor: Read-only local package presence, manifest identity/version agreement, plugin-relative skills/hooks references, reminder-hook shape/bounded timeouts, Python/Git and PATH client availability plus scratch ignore/record state. Malformed metadata, missing targets and escaping/symlink paths fail. Does not execute hook commands, launch clients, run builds, install, establish trust, validate host execution or qualify native runtime. Absent optional clients do not fail.
selfTest: Explicit plugin-only unittest regression execution from the complete repository checkout with temporary Git fixtures, inherited Git/client/Python overrides removed and bytecode disabled. JSON includes command, exit and captured output. Missing/symlink tests, zero tests, test failure or a 300-second timeout fail. Does not run product compilation/native GUI campaigns, install clients, write participant records or acceptance ledger, or infer acceptance. Not mandatory for ordinary GUI slices.
claim: Read-only claim --requirement ID --scenario NAME --evidence REPO_FILE (repeat) --scope OBSERVED_SCOPE --disposition NONACCEPTED --missing TEXT (repeat). Requires an owned participant record and real nonsymlink evidence plus existing selected sources. Copies exact original oracle/verification and current source/evidence hashes. Output claimSchema=1 packet is accepted by record --claim-file, alongside existing bare arrays; record revalidates all claims. Does not write, interpret evidence, update the ledger, appoint an external reviewer or allow accepted. Partial/blocked require explicit missing observations. Reviewer is the participant owner; historical prior claims are marked only in memory while preparing current hashes.
remaining: Read-only recorded backlog: --requirement ID (repeat), --status DISPOSITION (repeat) or --summary counts only. --limit POSITIVE_INT and --offset NONNEGATIVE_INT page matching rows in ledger order, retain total counts, omittedBefore/After, nextOffset and ledgerSha256; compare hashes when combining pages. --markdown prints a literal readable checklist with original given/when/then, verification, missing observation and recorded evidence scope; never checks accepted boxes. JSON retains complete original and ledger rows. Summary cannot paginate; Markdown cannot use global --json. Default excludes recorded accepted scenarios. Counts and dispositions are not revalidated acceptance or delivered-feature totals. Empty pages do not imply completion. Never selects work or changes the ledger; baseline is not the entire release scope. Optional repeatable --capability EXACT_NAME filters the union of selected capabilities, intersected with requirement filters, before counts and pagination. Unknown/duplicate capability names fail; capabilities lists valid names. JSON filters echoes the requirement/capability/status selection. An empty intersection does not establish completion.
review: Read-only participant handoff plus staged-byte and contribution-scope review. Declared sources and recorded evidence are allowed. --include REPO_FILE explicitly asserts owned support scope, never overrides protected foreign paths or permits archival implementation. Staged entries must be resolved regular files and match current bytes, including deletion. Missing records/mismatches fail; empty index advises. Does not stage, run QA, commit, publish or certify ownership/observations.
report: Read-only delivery note from an owned record. Global --json returns a reportSchema=1 packet; report --markdown renders reviewable prose and is incompatible with --json. Includes intended versus observed behavior, selected changes from initial hashes, uncommitted paths, exact oracles/verification, evidence scope/hashes, missing obligations and structural findings. No observation remains explicit; stale evidence fails with findings retained. Does not run QA, post, change records/ledger or infer acceptance. Source HEAD is not a tested source tuple for uncommitted drafts.
verifyPlan: Read-only proportional verification suggestions for changed declared sources since the last record; --selected plans all declared paths before edits. Returns existing runner paths/hashes, protected command argv, explicit unmapped/support changes, original obligations and stale-evidence findings. Never executes QA, certifies runner scope, infers current native tuple or accepts scenarios. No changes means no default rerun. Missing runners have no executable command; missing protected launcher requires a reviewed equivalent, never raw execution. Custom --record is preserved for native loop calls.
progressStatus: check/status/handoff/report/verify-plan include structured participant-record progress: iterations without meaningful progress, last progress baseline, elapsed seconds, exact 2-iteration/2700-second trigger reasons and slice-change action. This is self-attested progress, not measured GUI delivery. A trigger remains advisory and never globally blocks independent work or bypasses safety. Existing no-progress warnings remain.
extend: extend --path CANDIDATE_FILE --reason CONCRETE_DEPENDENCY (repeat path). Atomically adds unique dependencies to the same participant slice without changing owner, original IDs/oracles, start time, iterations, STATE or progress timer. Dirty paths require exact --adopt-dirty repository paths and --ownership-note; changed foreign snapshots cannot be overridden. pathExtensions records baseline hashes/absence and afterIteration positions, so declaration alone never becomes production-fix progress. Old claims retain original hashes and gain historicalAfterSliceExtension; fresh claims must identify the entire expanded tuple. Read-only handoff/report expose extension history. No builds, source edits, ledger changes or acceptance; use a new slice for different behavior.
capabilities: Read-only exact original capability groups, requirement IDs and recorded scenario-status counts, sorted by capability. Includes ledgerSha256; never selects work, modifies sources/records/ledger or establishes implementation, evidence freshness or acceptance.
preflight: Optional read-only preflight --slice-file REPO_JSON previews a bare slice or planSchema=1 packet before ownership creation. Validates selected originals, safe source paths and prospective Git-ignored record, reports selected dirty paths separately from other drafts with current hashes and absent new sources. Existing records and invalid ignore/parent paths fail. Selected dirty paths advise explicit genuine ownership; no adoption, reservation, lock/write, QA or acceptance. start rechecks current state. Both preflight and start reject changed copied originals or unsupported planSchema in packets; bare slices derive originals from the frozen baseline.
